contents: New to Claude Code? Run /powerup for a quick interactive tutorial
Start small, ask Claude for a plan, and check its edits
Use /config to change your default permission mode (including Plan Mode)
Use /color and /rename to tell your sessions apart
Garbled characters? Turn off terminal GPU acceleration in settings or run /terminal-setup
Claude edits notebook files, not your kernel. To get a cleared output back, re-run its cell and the cells that depend on it.

Press Shift+Enter to send a multi-line message

Run /terminal-setup to use Shift+Enter for new lines

Set COLORTERM=truecolor for richer colors
